title: Recover cargo test credit from a Claude-persisted full output (bounded, host-verified tool-results path) instead of refusing
outcome: A passing cargo test whose output Claude persisted to a file earns credit from the persisted file's bounded tail, read only from a host-derived and verified location, so agents need not rerun with -q.
acceptance: A design note agreed by the coordinator fixes: the host-derived canonical expected directory for the runtime's session tool-results, regular-file and no-reparse-escape checks, exact result ownership (tool_use id to path), bounded bytes, size and truncation validation against persistedOutputSize, and which summaries a bounded tail can and cannot vouch for.

Credit is granted only when the verified tail contains the passing summary and every safety check passes; any failed check falls back to the explicit output-cut refusal. Tests cover a valid persisted file, a path outside the expected directory, a reparse escape, a size mismatch, a missing file and a tail without a summary.
